messages:
Jordan: FYI I opened a docs PR for Private/VPC: split-tunnel VPN guide + Java TLS/HSM example. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4822
Maria: Nice. Quick scan: the HSM link points to an old path that 404s. The correct integration page is /integrations/hsm.
Jordan: Whoops, grabbed it from an outdated draft. Will update the link in the PR.
Chris: The Java snippet just calls `SSLContext.getInstance("TLS")` but doesn't show loading a keystore or how to wrap a PKCS#11 provider. New users will hit an exception at runtime.
Jordan: Good catch. I can add a minimal keystore load + a compact PKCS#11 note. Keep it short.
Ava: Diagram feedback: current networking flow has a single NAT gateway. For on-prem dual-homed appliances we should show SNAT + policy-based routing as an alternate path; otherwise people get the return-path wrong.
Jordan: Agreed. I'll add an alternate flow and a short MTU note: "If tunnel MTU < 1500, enable MSS clamping on the firewall". Want me to include an nftables one-liner?
Maria: Yes, include the smallest nftables snippet and a link to kernel conntrack timeout docs. Keep it inline, no long scripts.
Chris: Also, linkcheck CI flagged two broken anchors in the migration checklist and one missing image. docs-bot posted the report in the PR CI.
docs-bot: Linkcheck report for PR #4822: 2 broken anchors, 1 missing image. Report: https://ci.redwood.dev/docs/linkcheck/4822
Jordan: Thanks, I'll fix anchors and swap the image for the new network-topology.svg in the assets bucket.
Ava: For the CLI examples we have both `curl` and `httpie`. Keep both, but mark `httpie` preferred for readability and show the headers note ("httpie prints headers by default").
Chris: I'm consolidating SDK snippets into examples/sdk with a README that points to language folders. That should reduce churn when docs PRs move snippets around.
Jordan: Done a push: fixed HSM link, added keystore snippet, tiny nftables MSS clamp example, fixed anchors, swapped SVG. PTAL.
docs-bot: Docs lint: clean. Linkcheck: 0 broken anchors. Image network-topology.svg found. Preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.dev/pr-4822
deploy-bot: Preview site build queued for PR #4822. URL posted when ready.
Ava: Preview looks solid but the diagram alt text is missing the phrase "return path" for the dual-homed flow. Add it for accessibility.
Jordan: Updated alt text and diagram caption to mention dual-homed return path. Also added a one-line migration note for Dedicated customers about SNAT differences.
Maria: LGTM on networking and HSM link changes.
Chris: LGTM on Java and CLI snippets. Merging in 10 if no objections. :mergetrain: 
Jordan: Thanks! I'll follow up with a short ops-facing migration note and a support-facing troubleshooting blurb about MTU/SNAT.
Ava: Please add that troubleshooting blurb into the migration checklist post-merge. We had a support ticket last week where return traffic used the wrong interface.
Jordan: Added as a post-merge TODO in the PR description.
